info.name: List test runs for a project

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to retrieve.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of entries per page.

params.name: milestone_id
params.description: Filter runs linked to a specific milestone.

items.docs: Lists the manual test runs of a project. Returns active or closed runs with aggregated statistics. Supports filtering (for example by milestone, configuration, status, or start date).

info.name: List results for a test run

params.name: run_id
params.description: The ID of the test run.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to retrieve.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of entries per page.

params.name: status_id
params.description: Filter results by status (for example Passed, Failed, Blocked).

params.name: created_by
params.description: Filter results by the ID of the user who created them.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Only results created after this timestamp.

params.name: created_before
params.description: Only results created before this timestamp.

params.name: expands
params.description: Comma-separated related resources to expand (for example users,issues).

items.docs: Extracts and filters the individual test results of a manual test run. Results can be filtered by status, creator, and creation date, and related data can be expanded.
